# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Verify the accuracy of monitoring equipment and calibration procedures.
3. Collect continuous emission monitoring system (CEMS) data, if available.
4. Review facility compliance records and reports submitted to regulatory agencies.
5. Compare emissions data with the facility’s permitted emissions levels.
6. Document all instances where emissions exceeded permit limits.
7. Note the duration, frequency, and concentration of the excessive emissions.
8. Include details of meteorological conditions during the episodes of excessive emissions.
9. Review stack test results and other emission source test data.
10. Confirm the methodology used for collecting and analyzing emissions data.
11. Record any changes in operational parameters that coincided with excessive emissions.
12. Detail the facility’s response to the exceedances, including corrective actions taken.
13. Identify any patterns or trends in the data indicating systematic issues.
14. Provide photographic or videographic evidence, if available.
15. Include relevant historical data to show any trends over time.
16.
